6eec7cb1-0df7-4d1b-9c31-9a1a2509f5f0.title: Host-memory hazards in CCP and SMN/x86 externs (libafl review #928)
6eec7cb1-0df7-4d1b-9c31-9a1a2509f5f0.description: Priority order: CCP lsb OOB (ccp_sha ctx_id unbounded; get_raw_ptr SB addr+len wrap; ccp_copy_to_host/guest SB memcpy unchecked; AES dst_addr uses DST_LO twice and dst memtype uses SRC_MEM); aspfuzz_write_smn_flash unbounded memcpy; aspfuzz_smn_read/write signed size, aspfuzz_x86_* no checks; dead aspfuzz_smn_slots/state/update_slot; then sha_ctx type confusion, NULL map hangs, uninit leaks, vmstate for SMN slots/x86 mapper, access-observer uninit value. MUST NOT touch guest-memory copy semantics of CCP passthrough (Zen1 bug). Base claude/psp-fidelity-4.
